project.name: master-plan toolkit
project.description: Spec-driven planning CLI and agent skill (crates/mp)

goals: Ship agent-ready mp CLI for the full planning pipeline
Dogfood master-plan in this repo to track toolkit work
Maintain agent-only mp CLI + human-facing raul surface
CLI grouping redesign (Docker-style) is implemented and documented
Grooming discipline: every step has a test, every AC is covered by a step

adoption_order.reason: M16 unblocks the v1.1 wave; M17/M18/M19 depend on plan hygiene
M30 verify gate first — hardens completion of the debt; ships as v1.3.1
debt order per pilot-pending: M18 -> M21 -> M20 dep chain (M19 independent)
M41 strips mp human output first so M43 authors annotation commands json-only (mirrors idea.rs); avoids writing human rendering that M41 would then delete
M44 TUI consumes the annotation system (M44 depends_on M43; pin records the why)
design the grouping over the final post-M41/M43 surface, with the raul read layer settled
M45 impl consumes M38 design output; the rename is one clean pass over the final surface
M56 harness registry is the foundation M51 consumes; M51 install engine reads the registry and the --print-paths bridge
M51 deploys the spec-grill skill authored in M39
mp-read-ergonomics is foundational for mp-flow and mp-code-review skills; should land before the docs-heavy M81/M80 milestones and the GA tag M96
mp-flow skill builds on mp-read-ergonomics (M97) and the lessons doc; should land before GA
mp-code-review skill builds on mp-read-ergonomics (M97) and the lessons doc; should land before GA
